title: Price Velocity at Change
scenario: For every price change, calculate the 'velocity' as (price_change_amount / days_since_last_change). Return 'product_id', 'change_date', and 'velocity'.
tableSchema: products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE)
hint: Use LAG to find the previous price and date, calculate date diff, and divide.
correctQuery: SELECT product_id, change_date, (new_price - LAG(new_price) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY change_date))::FLOAT / NULLIF(change_date - LAG(change_date) OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY change_date), 0) AS velocity FROM products;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE products (product_id INT, new_price INT, change_date DATE); INSERT INTO products VALUES (1, 20, '2019-08-14'), (1, 30, '2019-08-16');
